profile_text.body:
Serve Robotics Inc. /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Carlos, California, trading under the ticker SERV, with CIK 0001832483. Its website presents self-driving delivery robots as an answer to the last-mile problem, asking why a 2-pound burrito should move in a 2-ton car. The company describes its offering as a low-emissions alternative and says it is setting a standard for safety on and beyond the sidewalk, protecting customer data, employees, and the public.

The site names Serve, its delivery robot, and Saymo, a robot it says moonlights as John Mulaney's sidekick on the show "Everybody's Live" when not delivering burritos. Serve Robotics describes itself as already a pop culture icon. No product entries are held for the company.

The held record lists no litigation cases. It flags California with a law exposure count of 264.
